requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Which accompanying document is attached - the arrest record copy, or the supporting affidavit
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Which accompanying document is attached - the arrest record copy, or the supporting affidavit
requiredBeforeFiling.why: Sec. 54-142v(a)(2) permits either document, the choice turns on what the participant's arrest record establishes, and the platform has seen neither
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: which of the two statutory accompaniments you are attaching: a copy of the arrest record, or your sworn affidavit where the arrest record does not establish the quantity or paraphernalia-use fact

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: The conviction as the court record words it, copied exactly
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: The conviction as the court record words it, copied exactly
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the record's own wording controls and the platform has not seen it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the conviction exactly as the record words it

requiredBeforeFiling.why: no conviction fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the conviction date, confirmed on the case look-up and the record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Statute of the conviction, as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Statute of the conviction, as the record states it
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which statute the conviction was under is a case fact the record states and the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the statute of conviction exactly as the record states it - Sec. 21a-279, Sec. 21a-267(a) or Sec. 21a-277(b); if the record shows a different statute, stop, because the petition does not fit

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Every count on this docket, listed from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Every count on this docket, listed from the record
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the legal-design record forbids asserting that all counts are erasable unless the participant has confirmed the count list from the record, so the list and the confirmation are the participant's
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the complete count list, from the Judicial Branch case look-up and the record, after confirming every count is within Sec. 54-142v - Sec. 54-142v(b) bars erasure of a record referencing more than one count unless every count is entitled to erasure

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Superior Court location in the caption of the petition - the Judicial District or G.A. location
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Superior Court location in the caption of the petition - the Judicial District or G.A. location
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which Superior Court location holds the case is a case fact on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Superior Court location - where the conviction was effected, or the location having custody of the records; for a pre-Superior-Court conviction, where venue would currently exist - the office of that court can confirm it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Docket number of the case, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Docket number of the case, on the petition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the docket number, confirmed on the Connecticut Judicial Branch online case look-up

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Superior Court location in the caption of the affidavit - the Judicial District or G.A. location
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Superior Court location in the caption of the affidavit - the Judicial District or G.A. location
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which Superior Court location holds the case is a case fact on a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Superior Court location - where the conviction was effected, or the location having custody of the records; for a pre-Superior-Court conviction, where venue would currently exist - the office of that court can confirm it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Docket number of the case, on the affidavit
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Docket number of the case, on the affidavit
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no case identifier is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the docket number, confirmed on the Connecticut Judicial Branch online case look-up

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own sworn statement of what the paraphernalia was used or intended to be used for
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own sworn statement of what the paraphernalia was used or intended to be used for
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the legal-design record forbids characterising what the paraphernalia was used for; the fact is the petitioner's own
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: for a Sec. 21a-267(a) conviction only: your own sworn statement of what the paraphernalia was used or intended to be used for - never characterised by this packet

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Your own sworn statement of the quantity involved, or the number of plants grown inside your own primary residence
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Your own sworn statement of the quantity involved, or the number of plants grown inside your own primary residence
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the legal-design record forbids generating the quantity possessed, distributed or grown; the affidavit is a container for the petitioner's own sworn fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: your own sworn statement of the quantity, or the number of plants grown inside your own primary residence for personal use - this fact is yours alone, and this packet never generates or estimates it
